A salon on Orestiados

Mangelo Hair and Beauty is on Orestiados in Larnaca, open five days a week, with 5.800 followers on Facebook. The salon’s own photos show bridal updos, curls and long waves, and a room with dark teal walls and an ivy covered shelf. There is no website of its own: the website field in the Google listing points only to Facebook.

What customers say

Four of 117 Google reviews, 4.8 stars on average.
